guide.title: Keep one task alive across two real documents
guide.titleZh: 让一条任务跨过两个真实 document
intro: The list and detail page are ordinary HTML documents. Opening a record performs a full navigation, so the page, action registry, and DOM are rebuilt.
Only the pending task survives. The detail document reconnects its own controls and continues the work; when it finishes, the task returns to the list.
introZh: 列表页与详情页都是普通 HTML document。打开一条记录会执行整页导航，页面、动作注册表和 DOM 都会重建。
只有待完成任务会保留。详情 document 重新声明自己的控件并继续执行；完成后任务回到列表。

steps.title: Create a runtime in each document
steps.titleZh: 每个 document 各自创建运行时
steps.body: There is no long-lived application shell. Each document creates the runtime it needs, registers the page identity, and binds the controls that are present now.
steps.bodyZh: 这里没有长期存活的应用壳层。每个 document 创建自己的运行时，登记当前页面身份，并绑定此刻真实存在的控件。

steps.title: Declare a stable record before navigation
steps.titleZh: 在导航前声明稳定记录
steps.body: The task starts from a record with a stable customer id. The following document can use that identity instead of repeating the user's sentence.
steps.bodyZh: 任务从带有稳定客户 id 的记录开始。下一个 document 可以使用这个身份继续，而不必让用户重复一遍任务。

steps.title: Use ordinary navigation
steps.body: The open action calls the same navigation path as a person. Pling records the pending work before the document is replaced.
steps.bodyZh: 打开动作调用与真人相同的导航路径。Pling 在 document 被替换前记录待完成任务。

steps.title: Resume, then finish explicitly
steps.body: The second document declares its own note field and save action. Once the result is verified, the continuity layer closes the task and follows the configured return path.
steps.bodyZh: 第二个 document 声明自己的备注输入与保存动作。结果验证完成后，连续性层结束任务，并沿配置的返回路径回到列表。

guide.note: Ask for “Globex的备注为：周五约吃饭”. The assistant opens the detail document, fills the note, saves it, and returns to the list once.
guide.noteZh: 输入「Globex的备注为：周五约吃饭」。助手会打开详情 document、填写备注、保存，并在完成后只返回列表一次。
